I. GENERAL
As we have collectively known that the protection of women and children victims of violence nowadays needs to receive serious attention, particularly Magelang City in implementing the Women's Empowerment and Child Protection program, this is as stipulated in the Medium-Term Development Plan of Magelang City for the Year 2011-2015.
This is to provide understanding that every Citizen has the right to obtain a sense of security and freedom from all forms of violence, especially in the Household and those who potentially become victims are generally women, likewise acts of violence and exploitation against children.
Therefore it is expected that particularly women can know and understand various aspects regarding domestic violence.
As mandated in Law Number 23 of 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence, it has been stated that all forms of violence, especially violence against Women and Children constitute violations of human rights and crimes against human dignity as well as forms of Discrimination that must be eliminated, so that they must receive protection from the State and or society in order to avoid and be free from violence, threats of torture or treatment that degrades the degree and dignity of humanity.
Statistically, cases of violence against women and children in Magelang City are relatively small, this is proven in the Year 2011 Magelang City received the Anugerah Parahita Ekapraya Intermediate Level award from the President of the Republic of Indonesia, this shows that the assessment of Women's Empowerment activities in Magelang City including the handling of acts of violence against women and children is relatively successful. However, the possibility of cases that still exist and must be handled continues to always receive attention.
In relation to this matter, the Magelang City Government needs to establish a Regional Regulation concerning the Implementation of Protection for Women And Children Victims of Violence that regulates clearly, firmly, and comprehensively to better understand and know various forms of acts of violence against women and children as well as where to seek protection.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is the City of Magelang.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor and regional apparatus as elements of the Regional Government administration of the City of Magelang.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Magelang.
4. Regional Apparatus Work Unit hereinafter abbreviated as SKPD is the regional apparatus in the City of Magelang.
5. Woman is an adult human being of female gender and a person recognized by law as a woman.
6. Child is a person who has not reached 18 years of age, including a child in the womb.
7. Child Victim of Violence is a child who receives harsh treatment either physically, psychologically, economically, socially, sexually, and other losses resulting from state policies, acts of violence and/or threats of violence within the scope of the household and community.
8. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
9. Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security and fulfilling the rights of victims carried out by family, integrated services, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily or based on court determination.
10. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutors, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.
11. Protection of children is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and worth, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
12. Implementation of protection is a series of activities aimed at preventing the occurrence of violence, providing protection and recovery services and social reintegration, conducting coordination and cooperation, and increasing community participation carried out by the Integrated Service Center.
13. Violence is any act that results in or causes misery and suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in public or in private life.
14. Violence against women is any act based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in public or private life.
15. Violence against Children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, economic exploitation, socially including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child.
16. Domestic violence is any act against a person especially women that results in misery or suffering physically, sexually, psychologically and/or household neglect including threats to commit acts of coercion or deprivation of freedom unlawfully within the scope of the household.
17. Prevention is direct efforts made by the Regional Government to prevent acts of violence against women and children.
18. Complaint is notification either in writing or orally by an interested party to an authorized institution, in which the person concerned suffers loss due to the actions of another person.
19. Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by Professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
20. Integrated Service is a series of activities to provide protection for women and children victims of violence carried out jointly by relevant agencies or institutions as a unified implementation, prevention efforts, health services, psychosocial rehabilitation, repatriation, social reintegration, and legal assistance for victims of gender-based violence and children.
21. Integrated Service Center for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is an institution providing services to victims of violence, carried out jointly by relevant agencies or institutions as a unified implementation, prevention efforts, health services, psychosocial rehabilitation, repatriation, social reintegration, and legal assistance for victims of gender-based violence and children.
22. Health Service is an effort that includes promotive, preventive, curative and rehabilitative aspects.
23. Spiritual guidance is assistance in the form of services for spiritual strengthening so that sick people can rise to be closer to God so that a sense of calm, security arises, and mental health is achieved.
24. Legal aid is legal services provided by legal assistants or advocates to carry out the process of assisting witnesses and/or victims of violence against women and children.
25. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.
26. Victim Recovery is all efforts to empower victims of gender-based violence and violence against children to be more empowered, whether physically, psychologically, socially, economically or sexually.
27. Assistance is all actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy, and spiritual guidance, for self-empowerment of victims of gender-based violence and violence against children to resolve the problems faced.
28. Social Reintegration is the process of preparing the community and victims that supports the reunification of victims into the family environment, family substitutes who can provide protection and fulfillment of victims' needs.
29. Safe House (shelter) is a temporary residence used to provide protection to victims in accordance with determined operational standards.

I. GENERAL
As we have collectively known that the protection of women and children victims of violence nowadays needs to receive serious attention, particularly Magelang City in implementing the Women's Empowerment and Child Protection program, this is as stipulated in the Medium-Term Development Plan of Magelang City for the Year 2011-2015.
This is to provide understanding that every Citizen has the right to obtain a sense of security and freedom from all forms of violence, especially in the Household and those who potentially become victims are generally women, likewise acts of violence and exploitation against children.
Therefore it is expected that particularly women can know and understand various aspects regarding domestic violence.
As mandated in Law Number 23 of 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence, it has been stated that all forms of violence, especially violence against Women and Children constitute violations of human rights and crimes against human dignity as well as forms of Discrimination that must be eliminated, so that they must receive protection from the State and or society in order to avoid and be free from violence, threats of torture or treatment that degrades the degree and dignity of humanity.
Statistically, cases of violence against women and children in Magelang City are relatively small, this is proven in the Year 2011 Magelang City received the Anugerah Parahita Ekapraya Intermediate Level award from the President of the Republic of Indonesia, this shows that the assessment of Women's Empowerment activities in Magelang City including the handling of acts of violence against women and children is relatively successful. However, the possibility of cases that still exist and must be handled continues to always receive attention.
In relation to this matter, the Magelang City Government needs to establish a Regional Regulation concerning the Implementation of Protection for Women And Children Victims of Violence that regulates clearly, firmly, and comprehensively to better understand and know various forms of acts of violence against women and children as well as where to seek protection.

I. GENERAL
As we have collectively known that the protection of women and children victims of violence nowadays needs to receive serious attention, particularly Magelang City in implementing the Women's Empowerment and Child Protection program, this is as stipulated in the Medium-Term Development Plan of Magelang City for the Year 2011-2015.

I. GENERAL
As we have collectively known that the protection of women and children victims of violence nowadays needs to receive serious attention, particularly Magelang City in implementing the Women's Empowerment and Child Protection program, this is as stipulated in the Medium-Term Development Plan of Magelang City for the Year 2011-2015.
This is to provide understanding that every Citizen has the right to obtain a sense of security and freedom from all forms of violence, especially in the Household and those who potentially become victims are generally women, likewise acts of violence and exploitation against children.
Therefore it is expected that particularly women can know and understand various aspects regarding domestic violence.
As mandated in Law Number 23 of 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence, it has been stated that all forms of violence, especially violence against Women and Children constitute violations of human rights and crimes against human dignity as well as forms of Discrimination that must be eliminated, so that they must receive protection from the State and or society in order to avoid and be free from violence, threats of torture or treatment that degrades the degree and dignity of humanity.
Statistically, cases of violence against women and children in Magelang City are relatively small, this is proven in the Year 2011 Magelang City received the Anugerah Parahita Ekapraya Intermediate Level award from the President of the Republic of Indonesia, this shows that the assessment of Women's Empowerment activities in Magelang City including the handling of acts of violence against women and children is relatively successful. However, the possibility of cases that still exist and must be handled continues to always receive attention.
In relation to this matter, the Magelang City Government needs to establish a Regional Regulation concerning the Implementation of Protection for Women And Children Victims of Violence that regulates clearly, firmly, and comprehensively to better understand and know various forms of acts of violence against women and children as well as where to seek protection.

I. GENERAL
As we have collectively known that the protection of women and children victims of violence nowadays needs to receive serious attention, particularly Magelang City in implementing the Women's Empowerment and Child Protection program, this is as stipulated in the Medium-Term Development Plan of Magelang City for the Year 2011-2015.
This is to provide understanding that every Citizen has the right to obtain a sense of security and freedom from all forms of violence, especially in the Household and those who potentially become victims are generally women, likewise acts of violence and exploitation against children.
Therefore it is expected that particularly women can know and understand various aspects regarding domestic violence.
As mandated in Law Number 23 of 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence, it has been stated that all forms of violence, especially violence against Women and Children constitute violations of human rights and crimes against human dignity as well as forms of Discrimination that must be eliminated, so that they must receive protection from the State and or society in order to avoid and be free from violence, threats of torture or treatment that degrades the degree and dignity of humanity.
Statistically, cases of violence against women and children in Magelang City are relatively small, this is proven in the Year 2011 Magelang City received the Anugerah Parahita Ekapraya Intermediate Level award from the President of the Republic of Indonesia, this shows that the assessment of Women's Empowerment activities in Magelang City including the handling of acts of violence against women and children is relatively successful. However, the possibility of cases that still exist and must be handled continues to always receive attention.
In relation to this matter, the Magelang City Government needs to establish a Regional Regulation concerning the Implementation of Protection for Women And Children Victims of Violence that regulates clearly, firmly, and comprehensively to better understand and know various forms of acts of violence against women and children as well as where to seek protection.
